QuestInfo.name: The Unknown Cause
QuestInfo.0: You eliminated the #o2230115#s and brought samples to the Dark Lord. He has one more task for you.
QuestInfo.1: Tell Matthias about the Muddy Swamp Monsters' transformation.
QuestInfo.2: Matthias said that he doesn't know much about the Muddy Swamp Monsters, but there have been lots of other monster transformations happening throughout Victoria Island.

0.0: Tell Matthias about the Muddy Swamp Monsters. The Cygnus Knights might have some special insight into this phenomenon...

yes.0: Make haste! This is only the beginning...

no.0: You dare turn me down? Fool!

yes.0: No, this is the first I've heard about the Muddy Swamp Monsters. But I'm hearing about this happening to other monsters all over Victoria Island. I'll look into it.

npc.0: Speak with Matthias about the transformation of the Muddy Swamp Monsters.
